snippet.title: Official Random Heroes 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
Random Heroes 2 by Ravenous Games Inc.

A group of unlikely heroes are set out to save the world.

Blast your way through these invaders in this action platformer!

It's time to eradicate the alien threat once and for all in Random Heroes 2!

Upgrade your weapons and characters to become stronger, faster and more lethal!

Choose your hero and save the world...again!

Available for iOS on the App Store - April 25 2013

Check us out at http://www.ravenousgames.com

Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/ravenousgames

Twitter: http://twitter.com/ravenousgames
